examples.arabic: هو رجع بيته فرحان في المساء.
examples.english: He returned to his house happy in the evening.
examples.transliteration: Howa rege beto farhan fel masa.

examples.arabic: مساء الخير يا ام احمد عاملة ايه
examples.english: Good evening, Umm Ahmed, how are you?
examples.transliteration: Masaa el kheir ya Om Ahmed, aamla eih?

examples.arabic: مريم رفعت السماعة وقالت مساء الخير يا سلمى
examples.english: Maryam picked up the phone and said, "Good evening, Salma!"
examples.transliteration: Maryam rafa'et es-sama'a w qalet masa' el-kheer ya Salma

examples.arabic: مساء الخير يا عيلة النهاردة هنجرب اكلة جديدة
examples.english: Good evening family, today we will try a new dish.
examples.transliteration: Masa' el-kheer ya 'eila el-naharda hanagarab akla gedeeda.

examples.arabic: مساء الخير يا ماما رايحين فين النهاردة
examples.english: Good evening mom, where are we going today?
examples.transliteration: Masa' el-kheer ya mama, rayhin fein el naharda?

examples.arabic: دي احلى لمة عيلة في مساء الخير
examples.english: This is the best family gathering on a good evening.
examples.transliteration: Di ahla lamma 'eila fi masa' el-kheer.
